summary: Iteration 82 - Strict Mode Conditioning Testing. ALL 37 TESTS PASSED (100%). The scanner correctly implements strict conditioning of controls based on isSimpleMode boolean. Simple mode (default) shows only capture button in camera, only Valider+Reprendre+Mode avance in preview. Advanced mode shows switch camera, gallery, filters, rotation, and Page suivante. Mode toggle works bidirectionally in guide and preview phases without resetting the preview image.
